LESSON: READING 15.2.1 READING FLUENCY

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 15
Topic 15.2: Reading 15.2.1 Reading Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 15.2.1 Reading Fluency, part of Strand 15 in Grade 9 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can you tell if a text is appropriate for reading? 2. Why should one read a text fluently?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. watch videos of a text being read,

2. read the title, blurb of a text jointly,

3. read the first line of a paragraph or chapter to establish the subject,

4. look for specific details from a text such as title, a word, a phrase in pairs,

5. practise ignoring unknown words while reading,

6. practise timed reading in groups with fluency,

7. read a text on tourist attraction sites in the world at the right speed,

8. pronounce words and sounds accurately,

9. display the right emotions and feelings

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. watch videos of a text being read,
2. read the title, blurb of a text jointly,
3. read the first line of a paragraph or chapter to establish the subject,
4. look for specific details from a text such as title, a word, a phrase in pairs,
5. practise ignoring unknown words while reading,
6. practise timed reading in groups with fluency,
7. read a text on tourist attraction sites in the world at the right speed,
8. pronounce words and sounds accurately,
9. display the right emotions and feelings

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 15.2.1 Reading Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and collaboration: It is fostered as the learner develops reading fluency.

Values:
Responsibility: It is nurtured as the learner makes a recording of text being read in pairs or groups.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Effective communication: It is promoted as the learner develops reading fluency.

• Citizenship: It is enhanced as the learner reads texts on various tourist attraction sites around the world.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Social Studies and Kiswahili encourage reading fluency.
